parts.label: a
parts.technique: Finding discrete probability distribution from cumulative distribution function
parts.reason: S4.1 covers 'simple, discrete probability distributions' generally; the explicit exclusion only removes calculation of mean and variance of discrete random variables, not deriving the pmf from a given cdf. This part only requires finding P(X=x) values from F(x), not E(X)/Var(X), so it is not caught by the exclusion.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Evaluating cumulative distribution function at a value
parts.reason: Same as above: reading off F(1.8) from a discrete distribution's cdf is basic discrete distribution work under S4.1, not mean/variance calculation, so it is not excluded.

parts.label: e
